Find every adult butterfly in the image. Include only adult butterflies; exclude moths, caterpillars, pupae, other insects, shadows and flowers. Draw one tight axis-aligned bounding box per butterfly, enclosing all visible wings, body, antennae and legs. For occluded or cropped butterflies enclose only visible parts; do not invent hidden parts. Estimate the four outer edges using these landmarks, then subtract left from right for width and top from bottom for height. Use three decimal places when useful. Do not confuse the horizontal and vertical directions.
